title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Jacksonville State Gamecocks and UC Davis Aggies, originally scheduled for Thursday, November 26, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Jacksonville State Gamecocks win, the market will resolve to "Jacksonville State Gamecocks".
If the UC Davis Aggies win, the market will resolve to "UC Davis Aggies".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Saturday, November 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
